crm_notes:
- Account: real-time bidding engine, low-latency reranking at edge of auction pipeline.
- Primary ask: bring p99 inference for 3-5 token-completion path down to ~5-8ms for core model (short scoring).
- Throughput profile: spikes to 6k rps for <100ms windows during peak auctions; sustained baseline ~400 rps.
- Cost sensitivity: target unit cost < $0.0008 per scored request across mixed traffic. Tight budget for inference.
- Model preferences: trimmed open variants (mosaic/llama variants), willing to test Redwood-verified quantized variants. Want deterministic fallback to smaller model if capacity constrained.
- Requirements: VPC deployment in us-east-1, SOC2 + SSO/SAML, KMS for key management, 2y log retention for audit.
- Performance levers they want to validate: batching thresholds (micro-batch vs single-request), prefix/KV caching for repeated customer IDs, int8/4 quantization impact on latency & quality.
- Quote from CTO: "We can tolerate a small repro rate if latency wins — but need clear QA metrics for quantization drift."
- Preference for Dedicated capacity with predictable throughputs + automatic burst to hosted in overflow scenario (routing policy).
- Initial ask from AE: 72-hour POC focused on p50/p95/p99 latency heatmap, cold vs warm cache; cost model tied to token counts and batching configs.
- Internal note: require sample traffic generator from client (we requested 24h of trace in anonymized form).
- Legal: DPA in negotiation; procurement timeline hinges on standard DPA + TOU updates.
- Sales tacticals: propose staged rollout: (1) Dedicated dev pool for POC, (2) Dedicated prod commit if numbers match, (3) Private deployment + extended retention once SLA signed.

sales_notes_short: High-priority enterprise adtech. Strong buyer intent for dedicated + private. Needs quantization QA and explicit cost-per-score model. Procurement in April if POC passes.
technical_summary: Latency-critical reranking use-case. Client wants microsecond-scale tail improvements via batching/caching/quantization. Key test metrics: p99 under burst, cold-start penalty, per-request cost at different batch sizes, quality delta at int8/int4. Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions and can provide anonymized traffic traces for realistic benchmarking.
next_actions_details: 1) Spin up dedicated dev pool for POC (3 nodes gpu-g6x). 2) Run baseline unbatched perf + single-request caching off. 3) Run systematic experiments: batch sizes [1,4,8,16], enabled prefix cache, quantization profiles (fp16, int8, int4), measure p50/p95/p99 and unit cost. Deliver report and recommendation deck.
